newsitem.title: USA: A&P says superstores hurt same-store sales.
newsitem.headline: A&P says superstores hurt same-store sales.

text.p: The Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co Inc said on Tuesday that its same store sales in the first quarter ended June 14 were hurt by the growing number of new A&P superstores.
The company increased the number of superstores in the northeastern United States, it said in a statement.

Total sales increased in the quarter with the help of the new stores and also strong performances in Canada, Michigan, its Food Emporium stores and a recovery at its Waldbaum's chain, Great Atlantic & Pacific said.
